title: Misconception-driven re-teach loop
description: After a Scan & Mark batch (PR #32 · FEAT-010), surface a 'Re-teach this gap' card per question that >40% of the class got wrong. One click → new worksheet that explicitly addresses the misconception via a worked example, contrast pair, and a fresh practice set. Closes the assess→re-teach loop entirely inside the product without the teacher leaving the page.
rationale: User's improvement #4. The assets already exist: ScanMarkDialog produces per-question correctness; misconception-bank.ts has 30+ curated UK misconceptions; PB7 (PR #33) added per-question misconception linkage; PC10 added a coverage map with misconception ids per question. This PR is the connective tissue — group misconceptions by frequency, build a re-teach prompt that references the specific misconception bank entry, generate, route the result through the existing render pipeline.
steps: Audit upstream: grep `extractMisconceptions`, `mergeMisconceptions`, `findMisconceptionById` to confirm how scan results expose misconception ids per question. Confirm `metadata.misconceptionLinks` is populated end-to-end before this PR runs.
- aggregateClassErrors(scanBatch: ScanBatchResult[]): { questionIdx; misconceptionId; pctWrong; pupilsWrong: string[] }[]
Pure function. ScanBatchResult is the existing per-pupil result shape from scan-mark.ts. Returns one row per (question, misconception), filtered to pctWrong >= threshold (default 40%, configurable).

- buildReteachBrief(row, sourceWorksheet, classRoster): { topic; misconceptionEntry; pupilsToTarget; instructions }. The instructions block hard-codes: 'This worksheet addresses ONE misconception specifically: <full text>. Open with a worked example that contrasts the correct method with the misconception. Provide 2 contrast pairs (one correct, one demonstrating the misconception with the error annotated). End with 6 fresh practice questions, increasing in complexity, with the answer key showing the diagnostic step.'
- aiGenerateReteachWorksheet(brief): wraps aiGenerateWorksheet with the brief's instructions appended. Stamps metadata.reteach = { sourceWorksheetId, misconceptionId, pupilsTargeted: [...] }.
- Mounted by ScanMarkDialog AFTER the marking grid. Props: scanResults: ScanBatchResult[], sourceWorksheet, onReteach(brief).
- Lists each gap row sorted by pctWrong desc. Each row shows: question stem, misconception text, pct wrong, names of affected pupils, and a single 'Re-teach this gap' button.
- Clicking the button calls onReteach(brief), which the parent threads through to a new aiGenerateReteachWorksheet call.
Wire ScanMarkDialog: after `Save to pupil` succeeds, render ReteachGapPanel below the dialog (or in a follow-on step). The dialog's existing close behaviour stays.

Wire Worksheets.tsx: add a `pendingReteachBrief` query param + sessionStorage handoff, mirroring the WeekAhead handoff from PR-4. When a teacher clicks 'Re-teach this gap' the dialog navigates to /worksheets?reteach=1 with the brief in sessionStorage; the page reads it on mount, calls aiGenerateReteachWorksheet, and renders.

Render: WorksheetRenderer already handles metadata.misconceptionLinks via the PB7 panel. Add a small 'Re-teach worksheet' badge in the header so the teacher sees the lineage. Footer: 'Re-teach for: <misconception text> · originated from <source worksheet title> on <date>'.
- client/src/lib/__tests__/reteachPlanner.test.ts — covers: aggregation thresholding, sort order, missing misconception id (skipped), buildReteachBrief instruction template stability.
Telemetry-soft: emit `reteach.suggested` (count) and `reteach.generated` (misconceptionId) via the same window.__adaptlyTelemetry pattern from Phase A · PR-4.
do_not_touch: Any AI prompt path; the brief is passed via additionalInstructions only
acceptance_criteria: Saving a 30-pupil scan batch where 14 pupils got Q3 wrong (47%) surfaces a 'Re-teach this gap' card on the same screen, naming the misconception.
Clicking the card lands on /worksheets with a re-teach worksheet rendered, NOT the original.
The re-teach worksheet's metadata carries reteach: { sourceWorksheetId, misconceptionId, pupilsTargeted: [...] }.
pnpm run check + pnpm run build + pnpm test --run pass.
verification: Manual: scan 6 photos with 3 deliberate Q3 errors; confirm a re-teach card appears; click it; confirm rendered worksheet addresses the right misconception.
context_budget_for_fresh_chat: LOW–MEDIUM. ScanMarkDialog (~280 LOC) + scan-mark.ts can be read in full. Worksheets.tsx is touched only via a small handoff useEffect — grep §HANDLE-GENERATE area, do not load the file.
